purpose.zh: 坐在椅子上拉开大腿后面
purpose.en: Stretches the back of your thigh from your chair.

text.zh: 一条腿伸直放前面，背挺直，上身往前倾
text.en: Straighten one leg out in front and lean forward with a long back

text.zh: 坐在椅子前半边，伸直那条腿脚后跟着地、勾脚尖。
text.en: Sit near the front of the chair, straight leg heel down, toes up.

text.zh: 伸直那条腿脚尖勾起来，大腿后面会拉得更明显。
text.en: Flex the foot of your straight leg to feel more in the back of your thigh.

text.zh: 呼气时肚子往大腿那边再靠一点，手放在大腿上别往下够。
text.en: Each breath out, bring your belly toward your thigh. Hands rest on your leg, don't reach.

commonErrors.en: Dropping your head and rounding to reach your toes.

commonErrors.zh: 伸直那条腿的膝盖往下压死
commonErrors.en: Jamming the straight knee down hard.

cautions.zh: 大腿后面疼或发麻就少往前倾点，还不舒服就停
cautions.en: If the back of your thigh hurts or tingles, don't lean as far. Stop if it still feels off.
